description: This file implements a React functional component for managing chat session settings in a user interface. It includes toggle controls for session management type (API-based or UI-based), displays session status, and provides functionality for copying session IDs.

methods.name: SessionManagement
methods.description: React functional component for managing chat session settings, including toggle switch, session status display, and copy-to-clipboard functionality.

methods.name: handleCopySessionId
methods.description: Copies the current response session ID to the clipboard and shows a success notification.

methods.name: getSessionDisplay
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current session display status, truncated response ID if available.

methods.name: getSessionDescription
methods.description: Returns a descriptive message about the current session management mode.
